name: Cendrillmon
main_effect:
＜Overclock ([Puppet] Trait)＞ (At the end of your turn, by deleting 1 of your Tokens or other [Puppet] trait Digimon, this Digimon attacks a player without suspending.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Familiar] Token. (Digimon/Yellow/3000 DP/[On Deletion] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.)
